name: o_score_flag_weights_paramized_defaults
description: v2.1 additive params: o_score_flag_points is now in WeatherRegimeParams. Default Taiwan values (night=5, weekend=2, road_closure=3, urgent_critical=5, urgent_warn=3, crowd_high=3, crowd_medium=2, operator_junior=2, long_mission_critical=3, long_mission_warn=2, plus thresholds urgent_critical_max_days=3, urgent_warn_max_days=7, long_mission_critical_min_days=7, long_mission_warn_min_days=4) preserve v2.0 behaviour exactly. With time_window=night + weekend=1 + crowd_density=medium, raw_sum = 5+2+2 = 9, o_score = min(12, 9) = 9 — well under cap.
